title: Australian Animals Bold & Easy Coloring Book for Toddlers
subtitle: 100 Big, Simple Pictures of Koalas, Kangaroos, Wombats & More for Kids Ages 2-5

back_text: Say hello to 100 adorable Australian animals — from sleepy koalas and bouncy kangaroos to chubby wombats, cheeky kookaburras, and splashing platypuses. Every picture has thick outlines and big open spaces made for little hands.
With 100 back-to-back pictures packed into one bumper book, toddlers and preschoolers get hours of screen-free colouring fun. Crayons and coloured pencils work best on these double-sided pages.
A wonderful gift for curious little animal lovers at home, on road trips, or in quiet time.

description_html:
100 big, bold Australian animals for little hands to colour!

Packed with 100 cute and friendly Aussie creatures, thick outlines and large open spaces — perfect for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2-5.

  • 100 cute pictures printed back-to-back for huge value
  • Thick, bold lines and simple shapes, easy to colour inside
  • Koalas, kangaroos, wombats, platypuses, echidnas, kookaburras, quokkas, emus, sea turtles and more
  • Each picture is labelled with a big hollow word to colour too
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages (crayons and coloured pencils work best)

A great gift for any little animal lover ages 2-5, ideal for birthdays, travel and quiet time.
cover_prompt: A bright, cheerful Australian outback and bushland scene for toddlers: a cute smiling grey koala holding a eucalyptus branch, a friendly brown kangaroo with a baby joey peeking out of its pouch, a round chubby wombat, a playful platypus splashing in a little creek, a smiling kookaburra on a branch, and a cute spiky echidna, with gum trees, golden wattle flowers, green grass, fluffy clouds and a sunny light-blue sky.
